source: Year 1 CCMAS B.Sc. Economics at UNIOSUN; year 2 and year 4 from UNN (socialscs.unn.edu.ng/economics-course-modules); year 3 from UNIBEN (waeup.uniben.edu). UNN publishes no year 3, so numbering differs between years.

courses.name: Introduction to Financial Accounting I
courses.summary: Accounting principles, double entry, ledgers and trial balance.

courses.name: Introduction to Financial Accounting II
courses.summary: Final accounts, adjustments, depreciation and financial statements.

courses.name: Introduction to Business I
courses.summary: Forms of business, management functions and business environment.

courses.name: Introduction to Business II
courses.summary: Marketing, operations, finance and organisational behaviour basics.

courses.name: Introduction to Population Studies and Demography
courses.general_name: Introduction to Population Studies and Demography
courses.summary: Population size, growth, fertility, mortality and migration.

courses.name: Principles of Economics I
courses.summary: Scarcity, demand and supply, elasticity, consumer theory, firms and market structures.

courses.name: Principles of Economics II

courses.name: Introductory Mathematics I
courses.summary: Algebra, functions and calculus basics for business and economics.

courses.name: Introductory Mathematics II

courses.name: Introduction to Employment Relations
courses.summary: Employer-employee relations, unions and workplace law.

courses.name: Communication in English

courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture

courses.name: Introduction to Political Science
courses.summary: State, government, ideologies, institutions and political systems.

courses.name: Introduction to Sociology I

courses.name: Statistics for Social Sciences II

courses.name: Macroeconomic Theory II

courses.name: Intermediate Mathematical Economics II
